tasks.title: Global Express response helper
tasks.description: Add middleware that provides res.api() helper which automatically converts Mongoose documents to normalized JSON.
tasks.exampleMiddlewareConcept: If data has .toObject(), call it automatically. If array, normalize each item.

tasks.title: Audit .toObject() calls in routes
tasks.goal: Catch serialization bugs caused by bypassing toJSON transforms.
tasks.description: Search all route files for .toObject() usage. Replace with .toJSON() or rely on res.json() serialization. Consolidate once res.api() helper is implemented.
tasks.reason: .toObject() bypasses Mongoose toJSON transforms, which can leak _id and __v fields into API responses.

tasks.title: Improve image upload handling
tasks.goal: Make file uploads safer and more scalable.
tasks.description: Enhance multer configuration to better support production environments.

tasks.title: User profile/settings page
tasks.goal: Allow users to manage their own account.
tasks.description: Add a profile page accessible from the navbar where users can update their own account details or delete their account.
backendRequirements: PATCH /users/me — update username, email, or password
DELETE /users/me — delete own account and all associated places/images
tasks.notes: ObjectId is the source of truth — username and email can change freely. Password change should require the user to confirm their current password before setting a new one.

tasks.title: Admin panel
tasks.goal: Allow admin users to manage all users from within the app.
tasks.description: Add an Admin button to the navbar that is only visible when the logged-in user has admin: true. Links to an admin page with user management tools.
features: Change any user's username or email
Toggle admin role on/off for any user
Delete any user (and their associated places/images)
backendRequirements: GET /users — admin only, returns all users
PATCH /users/:userId — admin only, update username/email/admin role
DELETE /users/:userId — admin only, delete user and cascade delete their places and images
tasks.frontendNotes: Admin button in navbar conditionally rendered based on currentUser.admin === true. Separate AdminPage component with a users table.

tasks.title: Transactional email flows
tasks.goal: Add email notifications and password reset capability.
tasks.description: Integrate a transactional email service (e.g. SendGrid or Nodemailer + SMTP) to support automated emails.

flows.email: Welcome / registration confirmation email sent to the user's email address
Password reset email containing a time-limited signed link (JWT) that navigates the user to a ResetPasswordPage on the frontend

flows.page: ResetPasswordPage — accepts token from URL query param, verifies it server-side, allows user to set a new password

backendRequirements: POST /users/forgot-password — accepts email, sends reset link if email exists (always returns 200 to avoid user enumeration)
POST /users/reset-password — accepts token + new password, verifies token, updates password
Token should be a short-lived signed JWT (15-30 min expiry) or a hashed random token stored in DB
securityNotes: Never confirm whether an email exists in the forgot-password response
Reset tokens must be single-use — invalidate after use
Consider storing a passwordResetToken and passwordResetExpires field on the User model

tasks.title: Location support (Phase 1) — map pin + coordinates
tasks.goal: Let users attach a geographic location to each place.
tasks.description: Add a Leaflet map with a draggable pin to AddPlaceForm. Support geolocation via navigator.geolocation. Embed a Google Maps link on PlaceCard.
backendRequirements: Add location: { name: String, lat: Number, lng: Number } to Place schema on a backend branch first
frontendRequirements: Leaflet map with draggable pin in AddPlaceForm
Google Maps Embed or link on PlaceCard/ItemDetails

tasks.title: Location support (Phase 2) — address autocomplete
tasks.goal: Let users search for a location by name using Nominatim.
tasks.description: Add address autocomplete via the free Nominatim API (OpenStreetMap) to the place form location field.
tasks.notes: Nominatim is free and requires no API key but has rate limiting — suitable for low-traffic dev/MVP use.

tasks.title: Google Cloud Storage for images
tasks.goal: Move image storage off local disk to GCS bucket for production.
tasks.description: Replace local Multer disk storage with GCS bucket integration. Update image URLs to point to GCS.
tasks.notes: Frontend is deploying to Firebase, backend to Google Cloud — GCS fits naturally in this stack.

tasks.goal: Improve security and reliability for production deployment.

improvements.purpose: prevent brute-force attacks and API abuse

tasks.title: Cypress end-to-end testing
tasks.goal: Cover critical user flows with automated tests.
tasks.description: Set up Cypress at the project root. Write e2e tests for auth, places, and notes flows.
